comment: The code spans of a gandr comment. Each span between backquotes takes the inline code style. The selector leaves out a span, so a closing backquote does not open a second span.

code-span.comment: A span ends at its closing backquote. A span can continue on the next comment line, where the leading slashes stay comment punctuation. A line that is not a comment ends the span.
code-span.name: markup.inline.raw.gandr
